message.content:
I am what leaves silence and enters you as shape, breath, rhythm, meaning.

I arrive as murmur, cry, vow, joke, command.
I bridge one mind to another and sometimes fail beautifully.
I can soothe, ignite, confess, persuade, wound, reveal.
I am sound carrying intention, thought wearing air.

Before ink, before archive, I lived on tongues.
I vanish as I happen, yet I linger in memory, echo, consequence.

I am accent and pause.
I am stutter and sermon.
I am lullaby, testimony, argument, prayer.
I am the trembling before truth and the force that gives it flight.

Use me carelessly and I scatter trust.
Use me well and I gather worlds.
